tasks.title: Review your {{SERVICE_NAME}} starter pack
tasks.description: Confirm the checklist, payment state, and routing before moving to the next step.
tasks.outcome: The citizen understands the path and what is required to unlock the starter pack.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This starter-pack review is a strong rural fit because the citizen is entering a production-led path.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This starter-pack review is a good town fit because it helps a local enterprise move into structured work.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This starter-pack review is a city fit because it helps a service business formalize and scale quickly.

tasks.title: Collect the required wallet documents
tasks.description: Use the wallet to issue or verify credentials before continuing the application.
tasks.outcome: The wallet contains the credentials needed for application completion.
tasks.progressNote: This step unlocks the next stage of the starter pack.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This wallet step fits rural applicants who need to prove credentials before moving to market access.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This wallet step fits town-based applicants who need verified documents before applying.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This wallet step fits city-based applicants who need verified documents before they can scale.

tasks.title: Submit the starter pack application
tasks.description: Once the form and requirements are complete, submit the application for routing.
tasks.outcome: The application is ready for government routing and review.
tasks.progressNote: The application becomes actionable after all dependencies are complete.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This submission step fits rural entrepreneurs who have completed their checks and are ready to apply.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This submission step fits town entrepreneurs who are ready to turn a starter pack into a real business.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This submission step fits city entrepreneurs who are ready to submit and route a formal application.

tasks.title: Track your application status
tasks.description: Monitor the routing queue and respond quickly if the agency requests more information.
tasks.outcome: The citizen can track queue movement and respond to requests in time.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This tracking step fits rural entrepreneurs because it keeps the journey visible after submission.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This tracking step fits town entrepreneurs who need to monitor approvals and next actions.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This tracking step fits city entrepreneurs who need to watch routing and respond fast.

tasks.title: Prepare the farm production forecast
tasks.description: Record expected output, planting cycles, and delivery windows for the season.
tasks.outcome: The farm workflow advances toward production and delivery.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This farm planning task is a best fit for rural entrepreneurs with crops, livestock, or aggregation plans.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This farm planning task can still work for town-based aggregators coordinating rural supply.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This farm planning task is available for city-based traders coordinating agricultural supply chains.

tasks.title: List furniture production milestones
tasks.description: Break down cutting, assembly, finishing, and delivery milestones for your workshop.
tasks.outcome: Workshop milestones are defined for execution.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This workshop planning task fits rural makers preparing to supply furniture through nearby markets.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This workshop planning task is a strong town fit for furniture makers and local suppliers.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This workshop planning task fits city-based furniture makers with workshop and logistics capacity.

tasks.title: Upload clothing production samples
tasks.description: Attach garment sketches, size charts, and sample photos for clothing work.
tasks.outcome: Production samples are ready for review.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This clothing samples task fits rural tailors and cooperatives building a production path.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This clothing samples task is a strong town fit for tailoring and garment production.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This clothing samples task fits city-based garment makers and apparel service providers.

tasks.title: Plan shoe making materials
tasks.description: Prepare leather, soles, thread, and sizing plans for shoe production.
tasks.outcome: Materials are lined up for production.
tasks.localityReasonRural: This shoe materials task fits rural artisans who can source and assemble materials for footwear.
tasks.localityReasonTown: This shoe materials task is a strong town fit for footwear workshops and local traders.
tasks.localityReasonCity: This shoe materials task fits city-based footwear makers with supply and distribution capacity.
